content:
anya: Quick sync from the observation RFC follow-up. We need a compact playbook for handling high-cardinality attributes: eviction, per-tenant streams, or hybrid. quick takes.

mike: Hybrid favoured. Eviction is cheap but breaks billing fidelity; full partitioning nails fidelity but multiplies ops.

tariq: Real incident note: billing.customer_id got trimmed during a peak and billing queries returned 'unknown' for several hours. That's a support/backfill headache.

lucy: Noisy tenants (many ephemeral keys) blow up query latency. Dedicated tenant streams localize that cost.

anya: Ops constraint: we can't explode the number of shards without hard caps. Proposal: fanout-to-dedicated for detected noisy tenants, otherwise slim+evict.

mike: Detection should be cheap: sliding 5m window of unique-attr growth + TPS. If both > threshold => promote to fanout stream for a window with cooldown.

tariq: Also provide a safelist for enterprise tenants who always get full fidelity. Avoid surprises for CS/legal.

lucy: Add a soft-flag when pinned attrs are missing instead of dropping traces: keeps trace context but surfaces attribution gaps.

anya: Gateway config sketch: pinned_attrs = ["billing.customer_id","tenant.id","service.name","env"], max_extra=25, missing_policy=flag. Fanout thresholds: tps=800, unique_growth=400/min, window=2h, cooldown=30m, max_dedicated=40.

mike: Fanout semantics: write slimmed event to main stream + full event to tenant stream. Query layer prefers tenant stream when available to avoid cross-shard joins. Admin dashboards can merge if needed.

tariq: Edge cases: flapping tenants. Mitigate via hysteresis and exponential backoff for re-promotions. Also bill tier-based caps so we don't allocate unlimited dedicated streams.

lucy: Security/retention: tenant streams need per-tenant KMS keys and retention policy review. Longer retention may be needed for billing disputes.

ingest-bot: spike task created by @anya -> OBS-PL-512 (https://phab.redwood/OBS-PL-512).

anya: Next actions: mike + tariq run a 4d spike to prototype detector + fanout and produce cost delta. lucy builds attribution evals and dashboard. I'll update the RFC with the playbook and config snippets.

lucy: I'll include a prompt/eval set to measure billing attribution false negatives and per-tenant attribution_loss over time.

mike: ack. posting spike plan and synthetic workload in this thread. :thumbsup:
